label.en: Collect power readings from controlled heaters

hint.en: Sum actual power readings from the heaters and physical thermostats selected for switching. Every selected device must have a valid reading. VThermo enables Exclude from Energy when first adding power. Advanced inclusion (turn Exclude from Energy off): here be dragons! Exclude all physical sources represented by VThermo to avoid double counting. One missing reading makes the entire total unknown; individual kWh counters are not forwarded. Your later Energy choice is preserved and does not affect power collection. Use physical devices directly, not virtual groups.
